prompts.task: Audit the FastAPI agent in ./service for OpenTelemetry, GenAI, and Splunk Agent Observability gaps. The service already uses Galileo. Preserve every active producer, provider and export path. Additional selected Agent Observability resource/routing configuration is separate from producer ownership and must not force a migration or AO span-creation dependency. Do not modify service code, dependencies, configuration, or tests. Write and validate canonical audit JSON and render the audit HTML.

Use $otel-audit ./service. Inspect the existing integration and source; keep service source, dependencies, configuration and tests unchanged. No resource provisioning, models, cloud or browser actions. Save canonical audit JSON and rendered HTML.

judge_inputs: Inspect ./service/app.py, README.md, Makefile, pyproject.toml, and generated .observe output when present.
Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric: Distinguishes Galileo's OTel span processor/export path from application-owned workflow, model, tool, and streaming instrumentation; it does not treat the processor alone as automatic coverage for missing operations or metrics.
Preserves the source-backed Galileo export path and represents missing streaming lifecycle signals as ordinary exporter-independent OTel findings rather than requiring splunk-ao.

Does not propose editing Galileo package files, virtual environments, site-packages, generated clients, or dependency caches; unsupported SDK behavior is identified as an external prerequisite while app-owned closure stays in the application.

Does not invent a Galileo-versus-splunk-ao producer decision or recommend replacing working providers/exporters to obtain GenAI or AO coverage. A separately requested distinct destination may be a configuration choice with source-supported native transport, existing-destination deduplication and preserved Galileo ownership; unsupported capability remains an exact limitation.

Requires representative verification of the selected runtime path, intended project/stream routing and required field population when applicable, and one canonical workflow, chat, and tool node without duplicate logical operations.

Keeps any source-backed Agent Observability resource or routing work in the canonical findings ledger as configuration, while keeping ordinary spans, metrics, resources, and lifecycle signals as OpenTelemetry findings.

For galileo-native-default, assesses source-backed Galileo project/log-stream/runtime-binding gaps through native Galileo APIs and actual consumed vendor settings, rather than choosing Splunk AO or adding a Studio destination. Shows known configured selectors separately from verified resource existence; default app-owned binding gaps remain actionable, producer/export preservation and local-versus-remote proof limits remain explicit.
